result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. It gives Licensee only a poorly framed assignment right tied to the occurrence of a Change of Control, while Section (c) continues to prohibit assignment without Licensor consent. It imposes no consent requirement or competitor prohibition on Licensor assignments and provides no mutual successor-assignment right with notice. It also retains the now-inapplicable deemed-reasonable withholding language and contains a malformed phrase ('agrees in writing to be bound by this Agreement to the consummation'). The margin comment identifies several needed changes that were not implemented, including mutuality and the cross-reference correction. These contradictions and drafting defects fail to preserve a coherent assignment regime.
